title: Algebra 2: Trigonometric Functions
tagline: From SOH-CAH-TOA to the unit circle and the sine wave — radians, reference angles, amplitude and period, ferris-wheel models, and the Pythagorean identity.

chapters.title: Right-Triangle Trig
chapters.description: The three ratios and their side names, solving for unknown sides, and inverse trig to recover angles.

chapters.title: Radians & Arc Length
chapters.description: The circle's native angle unit, degree↔radian fluency with π-fractions, and the payoff formula s = rθ.

chapters.title: The Unit Circle
chapters.description: Sine and cosine as coordinates, quadrant signs (A-S-T-C), reference angles, and the exact-value table.

chapters.title: Sine & Cosine Graphs
chapters.description: The wave unrolled from the circle — amplitude, midline, period 2π/b, and assembling y = a sin(bx) + d.

chapters.title: Modeling & the Pythagorean Identity
chapters.description: Ferris wheels, tides, and temperatures as sinusoids — plus sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 with quadrant-aware sign recovery.
